'''Ingas Lek''' was a [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] who led a group of 721 [[Human/Legends|Humans]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tuulab]] to establish a colony during the height of [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] reign.
